  • Method Details

    • withOutlierDetection

      public static LoadBalancer withOutlierDetection(LoadBalancer loadBalancer, @Nullable OutlierDetectionConfiguration outlierDetection)
      Apply the outlier detection configuration of a service to a load balancer, if it is one that can detect outliers: a round-robin one. Any other load balancer is returned as it is, so that a custom load balancer keeps controlling the selection.
      Parameters:
      loadBalancer - The load balancer
      outlierDetection - The outlier detection configuration, or null for none
      Returns:
      The load balancer
      Since:
      5.3.0

    • setOutlierDetection

      public void setOutlierDetection(@Nullable OutlierDetectionConfiguration outlierDetection)
      Stop selecting an instance that keeps failing, as configured, or ignore the reported outcomes with null. The ejection state starts over.
      Parameters:
      outlierDetection - The outlier detection configuration, or null for none
      Since:
      5.3.0

    • getNextAvailable

      protected ServiceInstance getNextAvailable(List<ServiceInstance> serviceInstances)
      The next instance: an instance that is up and that is not ejected by the outlier detection. When every instance that is up is ejected, one of them is selected anyway.
      Parameters:
      serviceInstances - A list of service instances
      Returns:
      The next available instance or a NoAvailableServiceException if none

    • report

      public void report(ServiceInstance serviceInstance, LoadBalancer.Outcome outcome)
      Description copied from interface: LoadBalancer
      Report the outcome of an exchange with an instance this load balancer selected, so that it can stop selecting an instance that keeps failing, see OutlierDetectionConfiguration. The clients report every load balanced exchange, except the ones the caller cancelled. Ignored by default.
      Specified by:
      report in interface LoadBalancer
      Parameters:
      serviceInstance - The instance the request was sent to
      outcome - The outcome of the exchange
